ai.title: Laid off by Amazon and Microsoft in 3 years, techie shares the golden rule for surviving AI-era job loss
ai.description: After being laid off by Amazon and Microsoft within three years, tech professional Dave Lewis was forced to rethink his career path in an industry increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence. The former Google employee eventually joined an AI startup after deciding to focus on roles that align with emerging technologies and long-term growth. His story comes at a time when AI-related layoffs are rising.

ai.description_cn: 在三年内被亚马逊和微软解雇后，科技专业人士戴夫·刘易斯（Dave Lewis）被迫重新思考他在一个越来越受人工智能影响的行业中的职业道路。这位前谷歌员工最终加入了一家人工智能初创公司，因为他决定专注于与新兴技术和长期增长保持一致的角色。他的故事发生在与AI相关的裁员正在上升的时候。

ai.title: AI Transformations: The Future Battlefield in Ukraine
ai.description: Artificial intelligence is poised to redefine warfare as Ukraine increasingly incorporates AI systems for battlefield decisions amidst its conflict with Russia. Head of Ukraine's AI center, Danylo Tsvok, foresees AI systems unifying into a single network, significantly speeding up military decision-making and potentially altering the conflict dynamics.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能转型：乌克兰的未来战场
ai.description_cn: 随着乌克兰在与俄罗斯的冲突中越来越多地采用人工智能系统来进行战场决策，人工智能准备重新定义战争。乌克兰人工智能中心负责人Danylo Tsvok预计人工智能系统将统一到一个网络中，显着加快军事决策并可能改变冲突动态。

ai.title: Craig Federighi Swipes at AI Rivals Who Are 'Racing Forward' Without Regard for Users
ai.description: Apple software chief Craig Federighi used the WWDC 2026 keynote to draw a pointed contrast between Apple's approach to artificial intelligence and the broader industry, suggesting that some competitors are developing AI without meaningful consideration for the people using it. During Monday's WWDC 2026 keynote, Federighi said: AI is incredibly powerful technology.
ai.title_cn: 克雷格·费德里吉（Craig Federighi）猛烈抨击“向前冲”而不顾用户的人工智能竞争对手
ai.description_cn: 苹果软件首席执行官克雷格·费德里吉（Craig Federighi）在WWDC 2026主题演讲中将苹果的人工智能方法与更广泛的行业进行了鲜明对比，这表明一些竞争对手在开发人工智能时没有为使用它的人考虑。在周一的WWDC 2026主题演讲中，费德里吉表示：人工智能是令人难以置信的强大技术。
